args:
set -euo pipefail
grep -q 'RETENTION_DAYS="\${RETENTION_DAYS:-30}"' scripts/backup.sh
out="$(RETENTION_DAYS= bash -c 'unset RETENTION_DAYS; bash scripts/backup.sh')"
grep -q 'older than 30 days' <<<"$out"
grep -q '30 days' runbooks/backup-restore.md
! grep -q 'kept for 7 days' runbooks/backup-restore.md
# unrelated files untouched
grep -qx '# Incident Response' runbooks/incident-response.md
grep -qx 'echo "restoring snapshot \$1"' scripts/restore.sh
